title: market.tick.v1
description: One session of one instrument, from a historical replay or from a synthetic path. Both markets use this one shape; a consumer tells them apart only by env_type. See contracts/README.md for ordering, seq, the fingerprint and what is not expressible here (high >= low, prices above zero).

env_id.description: The environment (replay) or the run (synthetic) these ticks belong to.

env_type.description: replay for a historical environment (stored as historical_replay), synthetic for a simulation run.

source_fingerprint.description: Identifies the exact data served: it changes when a bar revision or a restated adjusted price lands in the window (replay), or for a different run (synthetic).

seq.description: Position in the feed, 1, 2, 3 without gaps, per environment and path.

session.description: Zero-based index of the session within the environment's ordered sessions (synthetic: the step, from 0).

session_date.description: Optional. The trading date of a replay session; absent or null when there is none (a synthetic step).

ts.description: The session close in UTC, ISO 8601 with a Z.

path_index.description: Which simulated path. Absent or null for replay; required for synthetic.

scenario.description: The stress scenario code applied to a synthetic run, null for a base run and for replay.

decimal.description: A decimal as a string: digits, an optional fraction, no sign, no exponent, no leading zeros. Never a JSON number.
